                addon += "/fh/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality/75" + format;

                addon += "x-oss-process=image/resize,h_" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality,Q_75" + format;
            } else {
                addon += "imageView2/2/h/" + parseInt(height * ratio) + "/q/75" + format;

        return addon;

    var getBgHeight = function(windowHeight, bannerHeight, mobileBannerHeight){
        windowHeight = windowHeight || 560;
        if (windowHeight > window.screen.availHeight) {
            windowHeight = window.screen.availHeight;
        }
        bannerHeight = bannerHeight.trim();
        mobileBannerHeight = mobileBannerHeight.trim();
        if (window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth) {
            bannerHeight = parseFloat(mobileBannerHeight);
        } else {
            bannerHeight = parseFloat(bannerHeight);

        bannerHeight = Math.round(windowHeight * bannerHeight / 100);

        if (is_cdnimg(bgUrl)) {
            $.ajax(bgUrl, {
                xhrFields: {responseType: 'arraybuffer'}
            }).then((res) => {
                ab2b64(res).then((base64str) => {

        }

    var loadBannerDirect = function (backgroundImage, backgroundPosition, wrap, cdnType, width, height) {
        var background = wrap.querySelector('.blog-background');
        var imageSrc = backgroundImage + getImageAddon(cdnType, width, height);

        Mlog("Start Loading Banner Direct... url: " + imageSrc + "  cdnType: " + cdnType);

        if (typeof (backgroundPosition) === 'string' && backgroundPosition.length > 0) {
            background.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
        }
        loadBackgroundImage(backgroundImage, background);
    };
    var loadBanner = function (img, backgroundImage, backgroundPosition, wrap, cdnType, width, height, blured) {
        var background = wrap.querySelector('.blog-background');
        var container = wrap.querySelector('.lazyload-container');

        if (!background) {
            console.warn("background is null", background);
            return;
        }
        if (!container) {
            console.warn("container is null", container);
            return;
        }

        var imageSrc = backgroundImage + getImageAddon(cdnType, width, height);

        Mlog("Start Loading Banner... url: " + imageSrc + "  cdnType: " + cdnType);


        background.classList.add("loading");

        remove(img);
        if (typeof(backgroundPosition) === 'string' && backgroundPosition.length > 0) {
            container.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
            background.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
        }
        container.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + img.src + '")';
        container.classList.add('loaded');

        blured = blured || false;
        if (blured) {
            return;
        }

        // load Src background image
        var largeImage = new Image();
        largeImage.src = imageSrc;
        largeImage.onload = function() {
            remove(this);
            if (typeof imageLoad !== 'undefined' && imageLoad >= 1) {
                background.classList.add('bg-failed');
            } else {
                background.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + imageSrc + '")';
                background.classList.remove('loading');
                container.classList.remove('loaded');
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                remove(container);
                if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum >= 0) {
                    window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum ++;
                    Mlog("Loaded Banner: " + window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum);
                    if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum === window.asyncBannerLoadNum) {
                        window.asyncBannerLoadNum = -1170;
                        window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum = -1170;
                        $('body').trigger("ajax-banner:done");
                    } else if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum > window.asyncBannerLoadNum) {
                        console.error("loaded num is large than load num.");
                        setTimeout(function () {
                            window.asyncBannerLoadNum = -1170;
                            window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum = -1170;
                            $('body').trigger("ajax-banner:done");
                        }, 1170);
                    }
                }
            }, 1001);
        };
    };
    var loadPrefersDarkModeState = function () {
        var indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.className = 'dark-mode-state-indicator';
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
        if (parseInt(mGetComputedStyle(indicator, 'z-index'), 10) === 11) {
            LocalConst.PREFERS_DARK_MODE = true;
        }
        remove(indicator);
    };
    var mGetComputedStyle = function (element, style) {
        var value;
        if (window.getComputedStyle) {
            // modern browsers
            value = window.getComputedStyle(element).getPropertyValue(style);
        } else if (element.currentStyle) {
            // ie8-
            value = element.currentStyle[style];
        }
        return value;
    };
    var loadImage = function (imgUrl , imgEleId){
        var imgEle = document.getElementById(imgEleId);
        if (!imgEle) {
            return;
        }

        var fallbackSrc = imgEle.getAttribute('src') || 'https://www.91cg1.com/usr/themes/Mirages/images/banner.png';
        var imagePath = imgUrl.split(/[?#]/)[0];
        var imageExtension = imagePath.substring(imagePath.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase();
        var imageMimeTypes = {
            gif: 'image/gif',
            jpg: 'image/jpeg',
            jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
            png: 'image/png',
            webp: 'image/webp'
        };
        var imageMimeType = imageMimeTypes[imageExtension] || 'image/jpeg';

        if (is_cdnimg(imgUrl)) {
            $.ajax(imgUrl, {
                xhrFields: {responseType: 'arraybuffer'}
            }).then((res) => {
                ab2b64(res).then((base64str) => {
                    var decryptStr = decryptImage(base64str);
                    if (!decryptStr) {
                        imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
                        return;
                    }

                    imgEle.onerror = function () {
                        imgEle.onerror = null;
                        imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
                    };
                    imgEle.src = 'data:' + imageMimeType + ';base64,' + decryptStr;
                });
            }, function () {
                imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
            });
        } else {
            imgEle.src = imgUrl;
        }
    }

<script type="text/javascript">
    /** AI 入口弹窗脚本：pending 持久化与重连、首页返利闸门、子窗口关闭检测与会话结束上报 */
    (function () {
        if (window.__AI_OPENER__ && typeof window.__AI_OPENER__.initPage === 'function') {
            window.__AI_OPENER__.initPage();
            return;
        }

        var STORAGE_KEY = '__ai_opener_child_pending__';
        var WINDOW_NAME_KEY = '__ai_opener_child_pending_winname__';
        var PENDING_RECOVER_GRACE_MS = 10 * 1000;
        var watchersByEntryId = new Map();
        var unloadBeaconSent = Object.create(null);
        var lifecycleBound = false;
        var clickBound = false;
        var pageUnloading = false;
        var rebateRetrying = false;

        /** 判断窗口引用是否已无效（不存在或已关闭）；跨域访问 closed 抛错时视为已关闭 */
        function isWinClosed(win) {
            try {
                return !win || win.closed;
            } catch (err) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        /** 返回可用的浏览器 Storage 候选列表（localStorage / sessionStorage），用于读写 pending 状态 */
        function getStorageCandidates() {
            return [
                { name: 'localStorage', ref: window.localStorage },
                { name: 'sessionStorage', ref: window.sessionStorage }
            ];
        }

        /** 从 window.name 的 JSON 中读取预留 key，作为无痕模式下 pending 的兜底数据源 */
        function readFromWindowName() {
            try {
                if (!window.name) return null;
                var parsed = JSON.parse(window.name);
                if (parsed && parsed[WINDOW_NAME_KEY] && typeof parsed[WINDOW_NAME_KEY] === 'object') {
                    return parsed[WINDOW_NAME_KEY];
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
            return null;
        }

        /** 将 pending 对象合并写入 window.name（与其它字段共存）；空对象则移除预留 key */
        function writeToWindowName(storeObj) {
            try {
                var parsed = {};
                if (window.name) {
                    parsed = JSON.parse(window.name) || {};
                }
                if (!storeObj || !Object.keys(storeObj).length) {
                    delete parsed[WINDOW_NAME_KEY];
                } else {
                    parsed[WINDOW_NAME_KEY] = storeObj;
                }
                window.name = JSON.stringify(parsed);
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        }

        /** 读取各入口的「弹窗进行中」持久化记录：优先 local/sessionStorage，否则 window.name */
        function readPendingStore() {
            var candidates = getStorageCandidates();
            for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                var candidate = candidates[i];
                if (!candidate.ref) continue;
                try {
                    var raw = candidate.ref.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
                    if (raw) {
                        return JSON.parse(raw);
                    }
                } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
            }

            var fromWindowName = readFromWindowName();
            if (fromWindowName && typeof fromWindowName === 'object') {
                return fromWindowName;
            }

            return {};
        }

        /** 向单个 Storage 写入 pending 全量对象；空对象则 removeItem；失败返回 false */
        function writePendingStoreToBrowserStorage(storageRef, o) {
            try {
                if (!storageRef) return false;
                if (!o || !Object.keys(o).length) {
                    storageRef.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
                } else {
                    storageRef.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
                }
                return true;
            } catch (_) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        /** 将 pending 全量写入首个可用的 Storage，并同步 window.name 兜底（无痕等场景） */
        function writePendingStore(o) {
            var candidates = getStorageCandidates();
            var wrote = false;
            for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                if (writePendingStoreToBrowserStorage(candidates[i].ref, o)) {
                    wrote = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // 无痕/隐私模式下 storage 可能被禁用，window.name 作为刷新可恢复兜底
            writeToWindowName(o);

            if (!wrote) {
                console.warn('[AI入口] localStorage/sessionStorage 不可用，已降级到 window.name 存储 pending 状态');
            }
        }

        /** 生成 window.open 使用的固定 popup 名称，便于刷新后通过同名重新绑定同一窗口 */
        function getPopupName(entryId) {
            return 'ai_entry_popup_' + String(entryId);
        }

        /** 将存储里的单条 pending（数字时间戳或对象）规范为 { ts, popupName } */
        function normalizePendingRecord(raw, entryId) {
            if (!raw) return null;
            if (typeof raw === 'number') {
                return {
                    ts: raw,
                    popupName: getPopupName(entryId)
                };
            }
            if (typeof raw === 'object') {
                return {
                    ts: Number(raw.ts) || Date.now(),
                    popupName: raw.popupName || getPopupName(entryId)
                };
            }
            return null;
        }

        /** 标记某入口弹窗仍在进行中，写入持久化以便刷新后重连轮询 */
        function markPending(entryId, popupName) {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            o[String(entryId)] = {
                ts: Date.now(),
                popupName: popupName || getPopupName(entryId)
            };
            writePendingStore(o);
        }

        /** 清除某入口的进行中标记（会话正常结束或无需再恢复时） */
        function unmarkPending(entryId) {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            delete o[String(entryId)];
            writePendingStore(o);
        }

        /** 上次异常退出遗留：下次打开本页时补偿上报（仅处理超时未重连记录） */
        function recoverAbnormalPending(skipIds) {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            var keys = Object.keys(o);
            if (!keys.length) return;
            var nextStore = {};
            keys.forEach(function (id) {
                if (skipIds && skipIds[id]) {
                    nextStore[id] = o[id];
                    return;
                }
                var record = normalizePendingRecord(o[id], id);
                var ts = record ? Number(record.ts) || 0 : 0;
                var aliveMs = Date.now() - ts;
                if (aliveMs < PENDING_RECOVER_GRACE_MS) {
                    nextStore[id] = o[id];
                    return;
                }
                beaconSessionEnd(id, 'recover');
            });
            writePendingStore(nextStore);
        }

        function getAiApiBaseUrl() {
            try {
                if (typeof $Http === 'function' && $Http.defaults && $Http.defaults.baseURL) {
                    return $Http.defaults.baseURL;
                }

            return window.AI_API_BASE_URL || '';
        }

        function buildApiUrl(path) {
            if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(path)) return path;
            var baseUrl = getAiApiBaseUrl();
            if (!baseUrl) return path;
            return String(baseUrl).replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/' + String(path).replace(/^\/+/, '');
        }

        function buildEncryptedBeaconBody() {
            var token = null;
            try {
                if (typeof $LocalStorage !== 'undefined' && $LocalStorage && typeof $LocalStorage.get === 'function') {

                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

            if (!token) return null;

            var data = {};
            try {
                if (typeof $Oauth !== 'undefined' && $Oauth && typeof $Oauth.data === 'function') {
                    data = $Oauth.data() || {};
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

            try {
                if (typeof $CryptoData !== 'undefined' && $CryptoData && typeof $CryptoData.Encrypt === 'function') {
                    return $CryptoData.Encrypt(data);
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

        }

        function clearBeaconDebugState() {
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSent');
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSentAt');
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSentEntryId');
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSentReason');
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        }

        function markBeaconDebugState(entryId, reason) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSent', 'true');
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSentAt', String(Date.now()));
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSentEntryId', String(entryId));
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSentReason', String(reason || ''));
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        }

        function readBeaconDebugState() {
            try {
                if (localStorage.getItem('beaconSent') !== 'true') return null;
                var entryId = localStorage.getItem('beaconSentEntryId');
                if (!entryId) return null;
                return {
                    entryId: entryId,
                    reason: localStorage.getItem('beaconSentReason') || '',
                    sentAt: Number(localStorage.getItem('beaconSentAt')) || 0
                };
            } catch (_) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function retryBeaconRebateOnOpen() {
            if (rebateRetrying) return Promise.resolve(false);
            var beaconState = readBeaconDebugState();
            if (!beaconState) return Promise.resolve(false);

            var pendingStore = readPendingStore();
            if (!pendingStore[String(beaconState.entryId)]) {
                clearBeaconDebugState();
                return Promise.resolve(false);
            }

            if (typeof $Http !== 'function') {
                return Promise.resolve(false);
            }

            rebateRetrying = true;
            return $Http({
                method: 'POST',
                url: '/api/ainew/rebate'
            }).then(function (res) {
                var code = Number((res && (res.status || res.code)) || 0);

                }
                return false;

        /** 使用 sendBeacon/fetch(keepalive) 上报会话结束（返利等），同一 entryId+reason 去重 */
        function beaconSessionEnd(entryId, reason) {

            if (unloadBeaconSent[dedupeKey]) return false;
            unloadBeaconSent[dedupeKey] = 1;

            var url = buildApiUrl('/api/ainew/rebate');
            var body = buildEncryptedBeaconBody();
            console.log('url', url);
            console.log('body', !body ? 'body is null' : 'body is not null');
            if (!body) return false;

            try {

                var blob = new Blob([body], { type: contentType });

                    return true;

                        headers: { 'content-type': contentType },

                        keepalive: true,
                        credentials: 'omit'

                    return true;
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
            return false;
        }

        /** 安全读取当前页 pathname，异常时返回 '/' */
        function getCurrentPathname() {

                return (window.location && window.location.pathname) || '/';
            } catch (_) {

            }

        function isAiUserRechargeUrl() {

                p = (window.top && window.top.location && window.top.location.pathname) || '';

            clearBeaconDebugState();
            if (!keepPending) {
                unmarkPending(entryId);
            }
            console.log('==beaconOnly===', beaconOnly);
            localStorage.setItem('beaconOnly', beaconOnly);
            localStorage.setItem('entryId', entryId);
            localStorage.setItem('reason', reason);
            localStorage.setItem('opts', JSON.stringify(opts));
            console.log('[AI入口] 会话结束 id=' + entryId + ' reason=' + reason + (beaconOnly ? ' (beacon)' : ''));
            if (beaconOnly) {
                beaconSessionEnd(entryId, reason);
                tryRefreshUserAfterRebate();
            } else if (typeof $Http === 'function') {
                $Http({
                    method: 'POST',
                    url: '/api/ainew/rebate'
                }).then(function () {
                    tryRefreshUserAfterRebate();
                }).catch(function () { });
            }
        }

        /** 停止轮询并从 Map 移除；按子窗口正常关闭路径派发会话结束（HTTP rebate） */
        function finishWatcher(key, entry) {
            if (!entry) return;
            if (entry.timer) {
                clearInterval(entry.timer);
            }
            watchersByEntryId.delete(key);
            dispatchSessionEnd(key, pageUnloading ? 'pagehide' : 'child-closed', {
                beaconOnly: pageUnloading,
                keepPending: pageUnloading
            });
        }

        /** H5 后台标签 setInterval 会被节流；从 bfcache/前台恢复时要立刻扫一遍 */
        function probeAllWatchers() {
            var keys = Array.from(watchersByEntryId.keys());
            keys.forEach(function (key) {
                var entry = watchersByEntryId.get(key);
                if (entry && isWinClosed(entry.win)) {
                    finishWatcher(key, entry);
                }
            });
        }

        /** 仅清除定时器与 Map 项，不触发 rebate（用于即将重新 watch 同一入口） */
        function stopWatcher(entryId) {
            var key = String(entryId);
            var w = watchersByEntryId.get(key);
            if (w && w.timer) {
                clearInterval(w.timer);
            }
            watchersByEntryId.delete(key);
        }

        /** 对第三方弹窗启动定时检测 closed；可选写入 pending 供刷新重连 */
        function watchThirdPartyWindow(entryId, win, opts) {
            opts = opts || {};
            var key = String(entryId);
            stopWatcher(key);
            if (!opts.skipMarkPending) {
                markPending(entryId, opts.popupName);
            }

            var entry = {
                win: win,
                timer: null
            };

            /** 轮询：窗口已关则 finishWatcher */
            var tick = function () {
                if (isWinClosed(win)) {
                    finishWatcher(key, entry);
                }
            };

            entry.timer = setInterval(tick, 500);
            watchersByEntryId.set(key, entry);
        }

        /**
         * 页面卸载时清空所有 watcher，并以 beaconOnly + keepPending 派发会话结束（sendBeacon 通路）。
         * 需在 beacon 可靠发送的场景调用（如 pagehide 非 bfcache）。
         */
        function flushWatchersOnPageUnload(reason) {
            var keys = Array.from(watchersByEntryId.keys());
            keys.forEach(function (key) {
                var entry = watchersByEntryId.get(key);
                if (!entry) return;
                if (entry.timer) {
                    clearInterval(entry.timer);
                }
                watchersByEntryId.delete(key);
                dispatchSessionEnd(key, reason, { beaconOnly: true, keepPending: true });
            });
        }

        /**
         * 根据持久化的 popupName 尝试 window.open('', name) 附着旧窗口；失败或空白页则结束会话。
         * @returns {Object.<string, number>} 已成功重连挂轮的入口 id 映射（值为 1）
         */
        function tryReconnectPendingWatchers() {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            var keys = Object.keys(o);
            var reconnected = {};
            if (!keys.length) return reconnected;

            keys.forEach(function (id) {
                var record = normalizePendingRecord(o[id], id);
                if (!record || !record.popupName) return;
                var pendingWin = null;

                try {
                    pendingWin = window.open('', record.popupName);
                    if (!pendingWin) {
                        return;
                    }

                    // 能读到 about:blank 基本可判定为“未命中旧窗口而新建了空页”
                    if (pendingWin.location && pendingWin.location.href === 'about:blank') {
                        try { pendingWin.close(); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
                        dispatchSessionEnd(id, 'child-closed', { beaconOnly: false });
                        return;
                    }
                } catch (_) {
                    // 跨域读属性报错通常代表已命中旧窗口，继续挂轮询
                }

                watchThirdPartyWindow(id, pendingWin, {
                    skipMarkPending: true,
                    popupName: record.popupName
                });
                reconnected[id] = 1;
            });
            return reconnected;
        }

        /** 刷新进入后：先重连仍打开的弹窗 watcher，再对超时未恢复的 pending 做补偿 beacon */
        function runReconnectAndRecover() {
            retryBeaconRebateOnOpen().then(function (retried) {
                if (retried) return;

                var reconnectedMap = tryReconnectPendingWatchers();
                recoverAbnormalPending(reconnectedMap);
            });
        }

        /** 单次绑定 pagehide/pageshow/visibilitychange：卸载走 beacon，恢复时立即探测 closed */
        function bindLifecycleEventsOnce() {
            if (lifecycleBound) return;
            lifecycleBound = true;

            // 进入 bfcache（persisted=true）时不能清空 watcher，否则 pageshow 恢复后轮询已死
            window.addEventListener('pagehide', function (e) {
                if (e.persisted) {
                    return;
                }
                pageUnloading = true;
                flushWatchersOnPageUnload('pagehide');
            });

            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function () {
                pageUnloading = true;
            });

            window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (e) {
                pageUnloading = false;
                if (e.persisted) {
                    probeAllWatchers();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
                if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
                    pageUnloading = true;
                    return;
                }
                if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                    pageUnloading = false;
                    probeAllWatchers();
                }
            });
        }

        /** 新窗口先打开 about:blank 时的占位，避免等待接口期间纯白屏 */
        function writePendingTabPlaceholder(w) {
            if (!w || w.closed) return;
            try {
                const doc = w.document;
                doc.open();
                doc.write(
                    '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">' +
                    '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">' +
                    '<style>' +
                    'html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:#f2f3f5;color:#646566;' +
                    'font:15px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}' +
                    '.wrap{min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;' +
                    'padding:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 24px 24px;box-sizing:border-box}' +
                    '.sp{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}' +
                    '.sp i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#969799;' +
                    'animation:p .65s ease-in-out infinite alternate}' +
                    '.sp i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.sp i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}' +
                    '@keyframes p{to{opacity:.22;transform:scale(.82)}}' +
                    '</style></head><body><div class="wrap"><div class="sp"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>正在打开…</div></body></html>'
                );
                doc.close();
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        };

        /** 委托捕获 .ai-entry-link：登录校验、同步 open 占位、请求跳转 URL、上报 bringIn */
        function bindEntryClickOnce() {
            if (clickBound) return;
            clickBound = true;

            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var link = e.target.closest('.ai-entry-link');
                if (!link) return;

                e.preventDefault();
                var id = link.getAttribute('data-id');

                // 检查是否登录
                if (typeof $UserManager !== 'undefined' && !$UserManager.isLogin()) {
                    // 未登录，弹出登录框
                    if (typeof $WinOpen !== 'undefined') {
                        $WinOpen({
                            event: 'open',
                            datas: { key: 'LOGIN', url: '/popup/login/' }
                        });
                    } else {
                        $Alert('请先登录');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // 必须在用户点击同步阶段先 open，否则 $Http 异步回来后 window.open 易被拦截
                var popupName = getPopupName(id);
                var pendingWin = window.open('about:blank', popupName);
                writePendingTabPlaceholder(pendingWin);
                if (!pendingWin) {
                    $Alert('请允许浏览器弹出新窗口后重试');
                    return;
                }

                // 须在 $Http 返回前就挂轮询：用户若在 about:blank/占位页阶段就关窗，也能触发 rebate 带出
                watchThirdPartyWindow(id, pendingWin, { popupName: popupName });

                // 已登录，调用接口获取跳转链接
                $Http({
                    method: 'POST',
                    url: '/api/ainew/click',
                    data: { id: id ,from_type:'web'}
                }).then(function (res) {
                    if (res.status === 1 && res.data.auth_url) {
                        try {
                            pendingWin.location.href = res.data.auth_url;
                            setTimeout(function () {
                                if (!pendingWin || pendingWin.closed) return;
                                reportBringIn(id); // 调用 bringIn接口
                            }, 100);
                        } catch (err) {
                            pendingWin.close();
                            console.error('打开第三方页失败:', err);
                            $Alert('无法打开链接，请重试');
                            return;
                        }
                    } else {
                        pendingWin.close();
                        $Alert(res.data?.msg || res.data?.data?.msg || '获取链接失败');
                    }
                }).catch(function (err) {
                    pendingWin.close();
                    console.error('获取AI链接失败:', err);
                    $Alert('获取链接失败，请重试');
                });
            });
        }

        /** 第三方页打开成功后上报 bringIn（失败仅打日志） */
        function reportBringIn(id) {
            $Http({
                method: 'POST',
                url: '/api/ainew/bringIn',
                data: { id: id ,from_type:'web'}
            }).catch(function (err) {
                console.error('bringIn 上报失败:', err);
            });
        }

        /** 初始化：生命周期、用户信息闸门、首页返利、pending 重连与入口点击 */
        function initPage() {
            bindLifecycleEventsOnce();
            runReconnectAndRecover();
            bindEntryClickOnce();
        }

        window.__AI_OPENER__ = {
            initPage: initPage,
            tryReconnectPendingWatchers: tryReconnectPendingWatchers,
            watchThirdPartyWindow: watchThirdPartyWindow,
            getPopupName: getPopupName,
        };

        initPage();
    })();
    //TJ-104

</script>

    var registAutoHideElement = function (selector) {

            return;
        }
        var element = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (element && typeof(Headroom) !== "undefined") {

                offset : 5,
                classes: {
                    initial: "show",
                    pinned: "show",
                    unpinned: "hide"
                }
            });
            headroom.init();
            autoHideElements[selector] = headroom;
        }
    };
    var ab2b64 = function (t) {
        return new Promise(function (e) {
            const n = new Blob([t]);
            const r = new FileReader();
            r.onload = function (t) {
                const n = t.target.result;
                const r = n.substring(n.indexOf(",") + 1);
                e(r);
            };
            r.readAsDataURL(n);
        });
    };
    var getImageAddon = function (cdnType, width, height) {
        if (!LocalConst.ENABLE_IMAGE_SIZE_OPTIMIZE) {
            return "";
        }
        if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_LOCAL || cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_OTHERS) {
            return "";
        }
        var addon = "?";
        if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_UPYUN) {
            addon = LocalConst.UPYUN_SPLIT_TAG;
        }
        var ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        width = width || window.innerWidth;
        height = height || window.innerHeight;
        width = width || 0;
        height = height || 0;
        if (width == 0 && height == 0) {
            return "";
        }
        var format = "";
        if (LocalConst.ENABLE_WEBP) {
            if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_ALIYUN_OSS) {
                format = "/format,webp"
            } else {
                format = "/format/webp";
            }
        }
        if (width >= height) {
            if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_UPYUN) {
                addon += "/fw/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality/75" + format;
            } else if(cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_ALIYUN_OSS) {
                addon += "x-oss-process=image/resize,w_" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality,Q_75" + format;
            } else {
                addon += "imageView2/2/w/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/q/75" + format;
            }
        } else {
            if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_UPYUN) {
                addon += "/fh/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality/75" + format;
            } else if(cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_ALIYUN_OSS) {
                addon += "x-oss-process=image/resize,h_" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality,Q_75" + format;
            } else {
                addon += "imageView2/2/h/" + parseInt(height * ratio) + "/q/75" + format;
            }
        }
        return addon;
    };
    var getBgHeight = function(windowHeight, bannerHeight, mobileBannerHeight){
        windowHeight = windowHeight || 560;
        if (windowHeight > window.screen.availHeight) {
            windowHeight = window.screen.availHeight;
        }
        bannerHeight = bannerHeight.trim();
        mobileBannerHeight = mobileBannerHeight.trim();
        if (window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth) {
            bannerHeight = parseFloat(mobileBannerHeight);
        } else {
            bannerHeight = parseFloat(bannerHeight);
        }
        bannerHeight = Math.round(windowHeight * bannerHeight / 100);
        return bannerHeight;
    };
    var registLoadBanner = function () {

            window.asyncBannerLoadNum ++;
            Mlog("Loading Banner: " + window.asyncBannerLoadNum);

    var remove = function (element) {
        if (element) {

                element.remove();

                element.parentNode.removeChild(element);
            }
        }

    var is_cdnimg = function (path) {

            return false
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/new/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/xiao/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/upload/upload/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/upload_01/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/uploads/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/upload-images/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    var loadBackgroundImage = function (bgUrl , bgEle){
        if (is_cdnimg(bgUrl)) {
            $.ajax(bgUrl, {
                xhrFields: {responseType: 'arraybuffer'}
            }).then((res) => {
                ab2b64(res).then((base64str) => {
                    let ary = bgUrl.split('.'),decryptStr = decryptImage(base64str);
                    bgEle.style.backgroundImage = 'url("data:image/'+ary.pop()+';base64,'+decryptStr+'")';
                });
            })
        } else {
            bgEle.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + bgUrl + '")';
        }
    }

    var loadBannerDirect = function (backgroundImage, backgroundPosition, wrap, cdnType, width, height) {
        var background = wrap.querySelector('.blog-background');
        var imageSrc = backgroundImage + getImageAddon(cdnType, width, height);

        Mlog("Start Loading Banner Direct... url: " + imageSrc + "  cdnType: " + cdnType);

        if (typeof (backgroundPosition) === 'string' && backgroundPosition.length > 0) {
            background.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
        }
        loadBackgroundImage(backgroundImage, background);
    };
    var loadBanner = function (img, backgroundImage, backgroundPosition, wrap, cdnType, width, height, blured) {
        var background = wrap.querySelector('.blog-background');
        var container = wrap.querySelector('.lazyload-container');

        if (!background) {
            console.warn("background is null", background);
            return;
        }
        if (!container) {
            console.warn("container is null", container);
            return;
        }

        var imageSrc = backgroundImage + getImageAddon(cdnType, width, height);

        Mlog("Start Loading Banner... url: " + imageSrc + "  cdnType: " + cdnType);


        background.classList.add("loading");

        remove(img);
        if (typeof(backgroundPosition) === 'string' && backgroundPosition.length > 0) {
            container.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
            background.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
        }
        container.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + img.src + '")';
        container.classList.add('loaded');

        blured = blured || false;
        if (blured) {
            return;
        }

        // load Src background image
        var largeImage = new Image();
        largeImage.src = imageSrc;
        largeImage.onload = function() {
            remove(this);
            if (typeof imageLoad !== 'undefined' && imageLoad >= 1) {
                background.classList.add('bg-failed');
            } else {
                background.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + imageSrc + '")';
                background.classList.remove('loading');
                container.classList.remove('loaded');
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                remove(container);
                if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum >= 0) {
                    window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum ++;
                    Mlog("Loaded Banner: " + window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum);
                    if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum === window.asyncBannerLoadNum) {
                        window.asyncBannerLoadNum = -1170;
                        window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum = -1170;
                        $('body').trigger("ajax-banner:done");
                    } else if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum > window.asyncBannerLoadNum) {
                        console.error("loaded num is large than load num.");
                        setTimeout(function () {
                            window.asyncBannerLoadNum = -1170;
                            window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum = -1170;
                            $('body').trigger("ajax-banner:done");
                        }, 1170);
                    }
                }
            }, 1001);
        };
    };
    var loadPrefersDarkModeState = function () {
        var indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.className = 'dark-mode-state-indicator';
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
        if (parseInt(mGetComputedStyle(indicator, 'z-index'), 10) === 11) {
            LocalConst.PREFERS_DARK_MODE = true;
        }
        remove(indicator);
    };
    var mGetComputedStyle = function (element, style) {
        var value;
        if (window.getComputedStyle) {
            // modern browsers
            value = window.getComputedStyle(element).getPropertyValue(style);
        } else if (element.currentStyle) {
            // ie8-
            value = element.currentStyle[style];
        }
        return value;
    };
    var loadImage = function (imgUrl , imgEleId){
        var imgEle = document.getElementById(imgEleId);
        if (!imgEle) {
            return;
        }

        var fallbackSrc = imgEle.getAttribute('src') || '/usr/themes/Mirages/images/banner.png';
        var imagePath = imgUrl.split(/[?#]/)[0];
        var imageExtension = imagePath.substring(imagePath.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase();
        var imageMimeTypes = {
            gif: 'image/gif',
            jpg: 'image/jpeg',
            jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
            png: 'image/png',
            webp: 'image/webp'
        };
        var imageMimeType = imageMimeTypes[imageExtension] || 'image/jpeg';

        if (is_cdnimg(imgUrl)) {
            $.ajax(imgUrl, {
                xhrFields: {responseType: 'arraybuffer'}
            }).then((res) => {
                ab2b64(res).then((base64str) => {
                    var decryptStr = decryptImage(base64str);
                    if (!decryptStr) {
                        imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
                        return;
                    }

                    imgEle.onerror = function () {
                        imgEle.onerror = null;
                        imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
                    };
                    imgEle.src = 'data:' + imageMimeType + ';base64,' + decryptStr;
                });
            }, function () {
                imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
            });
        } else {
            imgEle.src = imgUrl;
        }
    }

                    var raw = candidate.ref.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
                    if (raw) {
                        return JSON.parse(raw);
                    }
                } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
            }

            var fromWindowName = readFromWindowName();
            if (fromWindowName && typeof fromWindowName === 'object') {
                return fromWindowName;
            }

            return {};
        }

        /** 向单个 Storage 写入 pending 全量对象；空对象则 removeItem；失败返回 false */
        function writePendingStoreToBrowserStorage(storageRef, o) {
            try {
                if (!storageRef) return false;
                if (!o || !Object.keys(o).length) {
                    storageRef.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
                } else {
                    storageRef.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(o));
                }
                return true;
            } catch (_) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        /** 将 pending 全量写入首个可用的 Storage，并同步 window.name 兜底（无痕等场景） */
        function writePendingStore(o) {
            var candidates = getStorageCandidates();
            var wrote = false;
            for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                if (writePendingStoreToBrowserStorage(candidates[i].ref, o)) {
                    wrote = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // 无痕/隐私模式下 storage 可能被禁用，window.name 作为刷新可恢复兜底
            writeToWindowName(o);

            if (!wrote) {
                console.warn('[AI入口] localStorage/sessionStorage 不可用，已降级到 window.name 存储 pending 状态');
            }
        }

        /** 生成 window.open 使用的固定 popup 名称，便于刷新后通过同名重新绑定同一窗口 */
        function getPopupName(entryId) {
            return 'ai_entry_popup_' + String(entryId);
        }

        /** 将存储里的单条 pending（数字时间戳或对象）规范为 { ts, popupName } */
        function normalizePendingRecord(raw, entryId) {
            if (!raw) return null;
            if (typeof raw === 'number') {
                return {
                    ts: raw,
                    popupName: getPopupName(entryId)
                };
            }
            if (typeof raw === 'object') {
                return {
                    ts: Number(raw.ts) || Date.now(),
                    popupName: raw.popupName || getPopupName(entryId)
                };
            }
            return null;
        }

        /** 标记某入口弹窗仍在进行中，写入持久化以便刷新后重连轮询 */
        function markPending(entryId, popupName) {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            o[String(entryId)] = {
                ts: Date.now(),
                popupName: popupName || getPopupName(entryId)
            };
            writePendingStore(o);
        }

        /** 清除某入口的进行中标记（会话正常结束或无需再恢复时） */
        function unmarkPending(entryId) {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            delete o[String(entryId)];
            writePendingStore(o);
        }

        /** 上次异常退出遗留：下次打开本页时补偿上报（仅处理超时未重连记录） */
        function recoverAbnormalPending(skipIds) {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            var keys = Object.keys(o);
            if (!keys.length) return;
            var nextStore = {};
            keys.forEach(function (id) {
                if (skipIds && skipIds[id]) {
                    nextStore[id] = o[id];
                    return;
                }
                var record = normalizePendingRecord(o[id], id);
                var ts = record ? Number(record.ts) || 0 : 0;
                var aliveMs = Date.now() - ts;
                if (aliveMs < PENDING_RECOVER_GRACE_MS) {
                    nextStore[id] = o[id];
                    return;
                }
                beaconSessionEnd(id, 'recover');
            });
            writePendingStore(nextStore);
        }

        function getAiApiBaseUrl() {
            try {
                if (typeof $Http === 'function' && $Http.defaults && $Http.defaults.baseURL) {
                    return $Http.defaults.baseURL;
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

            return window.AI_API_BASE_URL || '';
        }

        function buildApiUrl(path) {
            if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(path)) return path;
            var baseUrl = getAiApiBaseUrl();
            if (!baseUrl) return path;
            return String(baseUrl).replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/' + String(path).replace(/^\/+/, '');
        }

        function buildEncryptedBeaconBody() {
            var token = null;
            try {
                if (typeof $LocalStorage !== 'undefined' && $LocalStorage && typeof $LocalStorage.get === 'function') {
                    token = $LocalStorage.get('__token__');
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

            if (!token) return null;

            var data = {};
            try {
                if (typeof $Oauth !== 'undefined' && $Oauth && typeof $Oauth.data === 'function') {
                    data = $Oauth.data() || {};
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

            data.token = String(token);

            try {
                if (typeof $CryptoData !== 'undefined' && $CryptoData && typeof $CryptoData.Encrypt === 'function') {
                    return $CryptoData.Encrypt(data);
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }

            return null;
        }

        function clearBeaconDebugState() {
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSent');
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSentAt');
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSentEntryId');
                localStorage.removeItem('beaconSentReason');
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        }

        function markBeaconDebugState(entryId, reason) {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSent', 'true');
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSentAt', String(Date.now()));
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSentEntryId', String(entryId));
                localStorage.setItem('beaconSentReason', String(reason || ''));
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        }

        function readBeaconDebugState() {
            try {
                if (localStorage.getItem('beaconSent') !== 'true') return null;
                var entryId = localStorage.getItem('beaconSentEntryId');
                if (!entryId) return null;
                return {
                    entryId: entryId,
                    reason: localStorage.getItem('beaconSentReason') || '',
                    sentAt: Number(localStorage.getItem('beaconSentAt')) || 0
                };
            } catch (_) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function retryBeaconRebateOnOpen() {
            if (rebateRetrying) return Promise.resolve(false);
            var beaconState = readBeaconDebugState();
            if (!beaconState) return Promise.resolve(false);

            var pendingStore = readPendingStore();
            if (!pendingStore[String(beaconState.entryId)]) {
                clearBeaconDebugState();
                return Promise.resolve(false);
            }

            if (typeof $Http !== 'function') {
                return Promise.resolve(false);
            }

            rebateRetrying = true;
            return $Http({
                method: 'POST',
                url: '/api/ainew/rebate'
            }).then(function (res) {
                var code = Number((res && (res.status || res.code)) || 0);
                if (code === 1) {
                    unmarkPending(beaconState.entryId);
                    clearBeaconDebugState();
                    tryRefreshUserAfterRebate();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }).catch(function () {
                return false;
            }).finally(function () {
                rebateRetrying = false;
            });
        }

        /** 使用 sendBeacon/fetch(keepalive) 上报会话结束（返利等），同一 entryId+reason 去重 */
        function beaconSessionEnd(entryId, reason) {
            var dedupeKey = String(entryId) + ':' + String(reason);
            if (unloadBeaconSent[dedupeKey]) return false;
            unloadBeaconSent[dedupeKey] = 1;

            var url = buildApiUrl('/api/ainew/rebate');
            var body = buildEncryptedBeaconBody();
            console.log('url', url);
            console.log('body', !body ? 'body is null' : 'body is not null');
            if (!body) return false;

            try {
                var contentType = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8';
                var blob = new Blob([body], { type: contentType });
                if (navigator.sendBeacon && navigator.sendBeacon(url, blob)) {
                    markBeaconDebugState(entryId, reason);
                    return true;
                }
                if (window.fetch) {
                    window.fetch(url, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'content-type': contentType },
                        body: body,
                        keepalive: true,
                        credentials: 'omit'
                    }).catch(function () { });
                    return true;
                }
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
            return false;
        }

        /** 安全读取当前页 pathname，异常时返回 '/' */
        function getCurrentPathname() {
            try {
                return (window.location && window.location.pathname) || '/';
            } catch (_) {
                return '/';
            }
        }

        /** 判断 $Http 请求是否为用户信息接口（用于闸门延后） */
        function isUserInfoRequest(config) {
            var url = config && config.url;
            return typeof url === 'string' && url.indexOf('/api/user/userInfo') !== -1;
        }

        /** 将 axios 式实例上的自有属性、defaults、interceptors 拷贝到包装函数上 */
        function copyHttpProperties(source, target) {
            for (var key in source) {
                try {
                    target[key] = source[key];
                } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
            }
            try {
                target.defaults = source.defaults;
                target.interceptors = source.interceptors;
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        }

        /** 当前是否在 AI 充值相关路径（优先 top，跨域退化为当前页） */
        function isAiUserRechargeUrl() {
            var p = '';
            try {
                p = (window.top && window.top.location && window.top.location.pathname) || '';
            } catch (_) {
                p = '';
            }
            if (!p) {
                p = getCurrentPathname();
            }
            return p.indexOf('/ai/user/recharge') !== -1;
        }

        /** 在充值页会话结束时尝试刷新 top（或当前窗口），以更新登录态/余额展示 */
        function tryRefreshUserAfterRebate() {
            if (!isAiUserRechargeUrl()) return;
            try {
                if (window.top && window.top.location) {
                    window.top.location.reload();
                } else {
                    window.location.reload();
                }
            } catch (_) {
                window.location.reload();
            }
        }

        /**
         * 统一收口（子窗口正常关闭 / 页签卸载 / 恢复补偿）
         * @param {string} reason child-closed | pagehide | recover（recover 仅走 recoverAbnormalPending 内 beacon）
         */
        function dispatchSessionEnd(entryId, reason, opts) {
            opts = opts || {};
            var beaconOnly = !!opts.beaconOnly;
            var keepPending = !!opts.keepPending;
            clearBeaconDebugState();
            if (!keepPending) {
                unmarkPending(entryId);
            }
            console.log('==beaconOnly===', beaconOnly);
            localStorage.setItem('beaconOnly', beaconOnly);
            localStorage.setItem('entryId', entryId);
            localStorage.setItem('reason', reason);
            localStorage.setItem('opts', JSON.stringify(opts));
            console.log('[AI入口] 会话结束 id=' + entryId + ' reason=' + reason + (beaconOnly ? ' (beacon)' : ''));
            if (beaconOnly) {
                beaconSessionEnd(entryId, reason);
                tryRefreshUserAfterRebate();
            } else if (typeof $Http === 'function') {
                $Http({
                    method: 'POST',
                    url: '/api/ainew/rebate'
                }).then(function () {
                    tryRefreshUserAfterRebate();
                }).catch(function () { });
            }
        }

        /** 停止轮询并从 Map 移除；按子窗口正常关闭路径派发会话结束（HTTP rebate） */
        function finishWatcher(key, entry) {
            if (!entry) return;
            if (entry.timer) {
                clearInterval(entry.timer);
            }
            watchersByEntryId.delete(key);
            dispatchSessionEnd(key, pageUnloading ? 'pagehide' : 'child-closed', {
                beaconOnly: pageUnloading,
                keepPending: pageUnloading
            });
        }

        /** H5 后台标签 setInterval 会被节流；从 bfcache/前台恢复时要立刻扫一遍 */
        function probeAllWatchers() {
            var keys = Array.from(watchersByEntryId.keys());
            keys.forEach(function (key) {
                var entry = watchersByEntryId.get(key);
                if (entry && isWinClosed(entry.win)) {
                    finishWatcher(key, entry);
                }
            });
        }

        /** 仅清除定时器与 Map 项，不触发 rebate（用于即将重新 watch 同一入口） */
        function stopWatcher(entryId) {
            var key = String(entryId);
            var w = watchersByEntryId.get(key);
            if (w && w.timer) {
                clearInterval(w.timer);
            }
            watchersByEntryId.delete(key);
        }

        /** 对第三方弹窗启动定时检测 closed；可选写入 pending 供刷新重连 */
        function watchThirdPartyWindow(entryId, win, opts) {
            opts = opts || {};
            var key = String(entryId);
            stopWatcher(key);
            if (!opts.skipMarkPending) {
                markPending(entryId, opts.popupName);
            }

            var entry = {
                win: win,
                timer: null
            };

            /** 轮询：窗口已关则 finishWatcher */
            var tick = function () {
                if (isWinClosed(win)) {
                    finishWatcher(key, entry);
                }
            };

            entry.timer = setInterval(tick, 500);
            watchersByEntryId.set(key, entry);
        }

        /**
         * 页面卸载时清空所有 watcher，并以 beaconOnly + keepPending 派发会话结束（sendBeacon 通路）。
         * 需在 beacon 可靠发送的场景调用（如 pagehide 非 bfcache）。
         */
        function flushWatchersOnPageUnload(reason) {
            var keys = Array.from(watchersByEntryId.keys());
            keys.forEach(function (key) {
                var entry = watchersByEntryId.get(key);
                if (!entry) return;
                if (entry.timer) {
                    clearInterval(entry.timer);
                }
                watchersByEntryId.delete(key);
                dispatchSessionEnd(key, reason, { beaconOnly: true, keepPending: true });
            });
        }

        /**
         * 根据持久化的 popupName 尝试 window.open('', name) 附着旧窗口；失败或空白页则结束会话。
         * @returns {Object.<string, number>} 已成功重连挂轮的入口 id 映射（值为 1）
         */
        function tryReconnectPendingWatchers() {
            var o = readPendingStore();
            var keys = Object.keys(o);
            var reconnected = {};
            if (!keys.length) return reconnected;

            keys.forEach(function (id) {
                var record = normalizePendingRecord(o[id], id);
                if (!record || !record.popupName) return;
                var pendingWin = null;

                try {
                    pendingWin = window.open('', record.popupName);
                    if (!pendingWin) {
                        return;
                    }

                    // 能读到 about:blank 基本可判定为“未命中旧窗口而新建了空页”
                    if (pendingWin.location && pendingWin.location.href === 'about:blank') {
                        try { pendingWin.close(); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
                        dispatchSessionEnd(id, 'child-closed', { beaconOnly: false });
                        return;
                    }
                } catch (_) {
                    // 跨域读属性报错通常代表已命中旧窗口，继续挂轮询
                }

                watchThirdPartyWindow(id, pendingWin, {
                    skipMarkPending: true,
                    popupName: record.popupName
                });
                reconnected[id] = 1;
            });
            return reconnected;
        }

        /** 刷新进入后：先重连仍打开的弹窗 watcher，再对超时未恢复的 pending 做补偿 beacon */
        function runReconnectAndRecover() {
            retryBeaconRebateOnOpen().then(function (retried) {
                if (retried) return;

                var reconnectedMap = tryReconnectPendingWatchers();
                recoverAbnormalPending(reconnectedMap);
            });
        }

        /** 单次绑定 pagehide/pageshow/visibilitychange：卸载走 beacon，恢复时立即探测 closed */
        function bindLifecycleEventsOnce() {
            if (lifecycleBound) return;
            lifecycleBound = true;

            // 进入 bfcache（persisted=true）时不能清空 watcher，否则 pageshow 恢复后轮询已死
            window.addEventListener('pagehide', function (e) {
                if (e.persisted) {
                    return;
                }
                pageUnloading = true;
                flushWatchersOnPageUnload('pagehide');
            });

            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function () {
                pageUnloading = true;
            });

            window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (e) {
                pageUnloading = false;
                if (e.persisted) {
                    probeAllWatchers();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
                if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
                    pageUnloading = true;
                    return;
                }
                if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                    pageUnloading = false;
                    probeAllWatchers();
                }
            });
        }

        /** 新窗口先打开 about:blank 时的占位，避免等待接口期间纯白屏 */
        function writePendingTabPlaceholder(w) {
            if (!w || w.closed) return;
            try {
                const doc = w.document;
                doc.open();
                doc.write(
                    '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">' +
                    '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">' +
                    '<style>' +
                    'html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:#f2f3f5;color:#646566;' +
                    'font:15px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}' +
                    '.wrap{min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;' +
                    'padding:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 24px 24px;box-sizing:border-box}' +
                    '.sp{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}' +
                    '.sp i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#969799;' +
                    'animation:p .65s ease-in-out infinite alternate}' +
                    '.sp i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.sp i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}' +
                    '@keyframes p{to{opacity:.22;transform:scale(.82)}}' +
                    '</style></head><body><div class="wrap"><div class="sp"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>正在打开…</div></body></html>'
                );
                doc.close();
            } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
        };

        /** 委托捕获 .ai-entry-link：登录校验、同步 open 占位、请求跳转 URL、上报 bringIn */
        function bindEntryClickOnce() {
            if (clickBound) return;
            clickBound = true;

            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var link = e.target.closest('.ai-entry-link');
                if (!link) return;

                e.preventDefault();
                var id = link.getAttribute('data-id');

                // 检查是否登录
                if (typeof $UserManager !== 'undefined' && !$UserManager.isLogin()) {
                    // 未登录，弹出登录框
                    if (typeof $WinOpen !== 'undefined') {
                        $WinOpen({
                            event: 'open',
                            datas: { key: 'LOGIN', url: '/popup/login/' }
                        });
                    } else {
                        $Alert('请先登录');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // 必须在用户点击同步阶段先 open，否则 $Http 异步回来后 window.open 易被拦截
                var popupName = getPopupName(id);
                var pendingWin = window.open('about:blank', popupName);
                writePendingTabPlaceholder(pendingWin);
                if (!pendingWin) {
                    $Alert('请允许浏览器弹出新窗口后重试');
                    return;
                }

                // 须在 $Http 返回前就挂轮询：用户若在 about:blank/占位页阶段就关窗，也能触发 rebate 带出
                watchThirdPartyWindow(id, pendingWin, { popupName: popupName });

                // 已登录，调用接口获取跳转链接
                $Http({
                    method: 'POST',
                    url: '/api/ainew/click',
                    data: { id: id ,from_type:'web'}
                }).then(function (res) {
                    if (res.status === 1 && res.data.auth_url) {
                        try {
                            pendingWin.location.href = res.data.auth_url;
                            setTimeout(function () {
                                if (!pendingWin || pendingWin.closed) return;
                                reportBringIn(id); // 调用 bringIn接口
                            }, 100);
                        } catch (err) {
                            pendingWin.close();
                            console.error('打开第三方页失败:', err);
                            $Alert('无法打开链接，请重试');
                            return;
                        }
                    } else {
                        pendingWin.close();
                        $Alert(res.data?.msg || res.data?.data?.msg || '获取链接失败');
                    }
                }).catch(function (err) {
                    pendingWin.close();
                    console.error('获取AI链接失败:', err);
                    $Alert('获取链接失败，请重试');
                });
            });
        }

        /** 第三方页打开成功后上报 bringIn（失败仅打日志） */
        function reportBringIn(id) {
            $Http({
                method: 'POST',
                url: '/api/ainew/bringIn',
                data: { id: id ,from_type:'web'}
            }).catch(function (err) {
                console.error('bringIn 上报失败:', err);
            });
        }

        /** 初始化：生命周期、用户信息闸门、首页返利、pending 重连与入口点击 */
        function initPage() {
            bindLifecycleEventsOnce();
            runReconnectAndRecover();
            bindEntryClickOnce();
        }

        window.__AI_OPENER__ = {
            initPage: initPage,
            tryReconnectPendingWatchers: tryReconnectPendingWatchers,
            watchThirdPartyWindow: watchThirdPartyWindow,
            getPopupName: getPopupName,
        };

        initPage();
    })();

</script>

            let v = this.pop();

<script type="text/javascript">
    var autoHideElements = {};
    var CSS = function (css) {
        var link = document.createElement('link');
        link.setAttribute('rel', 'stylesheet');
        link.href = css;
        document.head.appendChild(link);
    };
    var STYLE = function (style, type) {
        type = type || 'text/css';
        var s = document.createElement('style');
        s.type = type;
        s.textContent = style;
        document.head.appendChild(s);
    };
    var JS = function (js, async) {
        async = async || false;
        var sc = document.createElement('script'), s = document.scripts[0];
        sc.src = js; sc.async = async;
        s.parentNode.insertBefore(sc, s);
    };
    var registAutoHideElement = function (selector) {
        var tmp = autoHideElements[selector];
        if (typeof(tmp) !== 'undefined') {
            return;
        }
        var element = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (element && typeof(Headroom) !== "undefined") {
            var headroom = new Headroom(element, {
                tolerance: 5,
                offset : 5,
                classes: {
                    initial: "show",
                    pinned: "show",
                    unpinned: "hide"
                }
            });
            headroom.init();
            autoHideElements[selector] = headroom;
        }
    };
    var ab2b64 = function (t) {
        return new Promise(function (e) {
            const n = new Blob([t]);
            const r = new FileReader();
            r.onload = function (t) {
                const n = t.target.result;
                const r = n.substring(n.indexOf(",") + 1);
                e(r);
            };
            r.readAsDataURL(n);
        });
    };
    var getImageAddon = function (cdnType, width, height) {
        if (!LocalConst.ENABLE_IMAGE_SIZE_OPTIMIZE) {
            return "";
        }
        if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_LOCAL || cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_OTHERS) {
            return "";
        }
        var addon = "?";
        if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_UPYUN) {
            addon = LocalConst.UPYUN_SPLIT_TAG;
        }
        var ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        width = width || window.innerWidth;
        height = height || window.innerHeight;
        width = width || 0;
        height = height || 0;
        if (width == 0 && height == 0) {
            return "";
        }
        var format = "";
        if (LocalConst.ENABLE_WEBP) {
            if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_ALIYUN_OSS) {
                format = "/format,webp"
            } else {
                format = "/format/webp";
            }
        }
        if (width >= height) {
            if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_UPYUN) {
                addon += "/fw/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality/75" + format;
            } else if(cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_ALIYUN_OSS) {
                addon += "x-oss-process=image/resize,w_" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality,Q_75" + format;
            } else {
                addon += "imageView2/2/w/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/q/75" + format;
            }
        } else {
            if (cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_UPYUN) {
                addon += "/fh/" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality/75" + format;
            } else if(cdnType == LocalConst.CDN_TYPE_ALIYUN_OSS) {
                addon += "x-oss-process=image/resize,h_" + parseInt(width * ratio) + "/quality,Q_75" + format;
            } else {
                addon += "imageView2/2/h/" + parseInt(height * ratio) + "/q/75" + format;
            }
        }
        return addon;
    };
    var getBgHeight = function(windowHeight, bannerHeight, mobileBannerHeight){
        windowHeight = windowHeight || 560;
        if (windowHeight > window.screen.availHeight) {
            windowHeight = window.screen.availHeight;
        }
        bannerHeight = bannerHeight.trim();
        mobileBannerHeight = mobileBannerHeight.trim();
        if (window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth) {
            bannerHeight = parseFloat(mobileBannerHeight);
        } else {
            bannerHeight = parseFloat(bannerHeight);
        }
        bannerHeight = Math.round(windowHeight * bannerHeight / 100);
        return bannerHeight;
    };
    var registLoadBanner = function () {
        if (window.asyncBannerLoadNum >= 0) {
            window.asyncBannerLoadNum ++;
            Mlog("Loading Banner: " + window.asyncBannerLoadNum);
        }
    };
    var remove = function (element) {
        if (element) {
            if (typeof element['remove'] === 'function') {
                element.remove();
            } else if (element.parentNode) {
                element.parentNode.removeChild(element);
            }
        }
    };

    var is_cdnimg = function (path) {
        if (typeof (path) !== "string") {
            return false
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/new/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/xiao/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/upload/upload/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/upload_01/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/uploads/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        if (path.indexOf("/upload-images/") !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    var loadBackgroundImage = function (bgUrl , bgEle){
        if (is_cdnimg(bgUrl)) {
            $.ajax(bgUrl, {
                xhrFields: {responseType: 'arraybuffer'}
            }).then((res) => {
                ab2b64(res).then((base64str) => {
                    let ary = bgUrl.split('.'),decryptStr = decryptImage(base64str);
                    bgEle.style.backgroundImage = 'url("data:image/'+ary.pop()+';base64,'+decryptStr+'")';
                });
            })
        } else {
            bgEle.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + bgUrl + '")';
        }
    }

    var loadBannerDirect = function (backgroundImage, backgroundPosition, wrap, cdnType, width, height) {
        var background = wrap.querySelector('.blog-background');
        var imageSrc = backgroundImage + getImageAddon(cdnType, width, height);

        Mlog("Start Loading Banner Direct... url: " + imageSrc + "  cdnType: " + cdnType);

        if (typeof (backgroundPosition) === 'string' && backgroundPosition.length > 0) {
            background.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
        }
        loadBackgroundImage(backgroundImage, background);
    };
    var loadBanner = function (img, backgroundImage, backgroundPosition, wrap, cdnType, width, height, blured) {
        var background = wrap.querySelector('.blog-background');
        var container = wrap.querySelector('.lazyload-container');

        if (!background) {
            console.warn("background is null", background);
            return;
        }
        if (!container) {
            console.warn("container is null", container);
            return;
        }

        var imageSrc = backgroundImage + getImageAddon(cdnType, width, height);

        Mlog("Start Loading Banner... url: " + imageSrc + "  cdnType: " + cdnType);


        background.classList.add("loading");

        remove(img);
        if (typeof(backgroundPosition) === 'string' && backgroundPosition.length > 0) {
            container.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
            background.style.backgroundPosition = backgroundPosition;
        }
        container.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + img.src + '")';
        container.classList.add('loaded');

        blured = blured || false;
        if (blured) {
            return;
        }

        // load Src background image
        var largeImage = new Image();
        largeImage.src = imageSrc;
        largeImage.onload = function() {
            remove(this);
            if (typeof imageLoad !== 'undefined' && imageLoad >= 1) {
                background.classList.add('bg-failed');
            } else {
                background.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + imageSrc + '")';
                background.classList.remove('loading');
                container.classList.remove('loaded');
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
                remove(container);
                if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum >= 0) {
                    window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum ++;
                    Mlog("Loaded Banner: " + window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum);
                    if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum === window.asyncBannerLoadNum) {
                        window.asyncBannerLoadNum = -1170;
                        window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum = -1170;
                        $('body').trigger("ajax-banner:done");
                    } else if (window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum > window.asyncBannerLoadNum) {
                        console.error("loaded num is large than load num.");
                        setTimeout(function () {
                            window.asyncBannerLoadNum = -1170;
                            window.asyncBannerLoadCompleteNum = -1170;
                            $('body').trigger("ajax-banner:done");
                        }, 1170);
                    }
                }
            }, 1001);
        };
    };
    var loadPrefersDarkModeState = function () {
        var indicator = document.createElement('div');
        indicator.className = 'dark-mode-state-indicator';
        document.body.appendChild(indicator);
        if (parseInt(mGetComputedStyle(indicator, 'z-index'), 10) === 11) {
            LocalConst.PREFERS_DARK_MODE = true;
        }
        remove(indicator);
    };
    var mGetComputedStyle = function (element, style) {
        var value;
        if (window.getComputedStyle) {
            // modern browsers
            value = window.getComputedStyle(element).getPropertyValue(style);
        } else if (element.currentStyle) {
            // ie8-
            value = element.currentStyle[style];
        }
        return value;
    };
    var loadImage = function (imgUrl , imgEleId){
        var imgEle = document.getElementById(imgEleId);
        if (!imgEle) {
            return;
        }

        var fallbackSrc = imgEle.getAttribute('src') || 'https://www.91cg1.com/usr/themes/Mirages/images/banner.png';
        var imagePath = imgUrl.split(/[?#]/)[0];
        var imageExtension = imagePath.substring(imagePath.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase();
        var imageMimeTypes = {
            gif: 'image/gif',
            jpg: 'image/jpeg',
            jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
            png: 'image/png',
            webp: 'image/webp'
        };
        var imageMimeType = imageMimeTypes[imageExtension] || 'image/jpeg';

        if (is_cdnimg(imgUrl)) {
            $.ajax(imgUrl, {
                xhrFields: {responseType: 'arraybuffer'}
            }).then((res) => {
                ab2b64(res).then((base64str) => {
                    var decryptStr = decryptImage(base64str);
                    if (!decryptStr) {
                        imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
                        return;
                    }

                    imgEle.onerror = function () {
                        imgEle.onerror = null;
                        imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
                    };
                    imgEle.src = 'data:' + imageMimeType + ';base64,' + decryptStr;
                });
            }, function () {
                imgEle.src = fallbackSrc;
            });
        } else {
            imgEle.src = imgUrl;
        }
    }
